verdict.rationale: Rippling is a SaaS HR/payroll platform with built-in AI features, so an opt-out from having customer data used for AI model training is a fair axis for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any training opt-out, data-use policy, or AI privacy control. The AI feature mentions and role-based access controls are adjacent and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
